faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to act as a pawnbroker within the city without
               first obtaining a license to conduct such business pursuant to this chapter.
(b)
All requirements specified in C.R.S. § 12-56-101 et seq., shall control and are hereby
               incorporated by reference in the event that inconsistent requirements are set forth
               in this article.
(Code 1981, § 23-2; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
